top_deficiency_types.title: Immediately tell the resident, the resident's doctor, and a family member of situations (injury/decline/room, etc.)  that affect the resident.
Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure medication error rates are not 5 percent or greater.
Safeguard resident-identifiable information and/or maintain medical records on each resident that are in accordance with accepted professional standards.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Install emergency lighting that can last at least 1 1/2 hours.
Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.
Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.
Add doors in an exit area that do not require the use of a key from the exit side unless in case of special locking arrangements.
Install smoke barrier doors that can resist smoke for at least 20 minutes.
Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies
